# Holaweb

> Holaweb brings Infooware operating software, AI agents and named experts to South African businesses. Solutions keep working through load shedding and weak signal, run alongside Sage, Xero, SAP and Odoo, and start with a conversation about the customer's problems, gaps and requirements, followed by a fixed-scope pilot. Contact: WhatsApp or call +91 63596 93055.

## Solutions
- [Healthcare Engagement & Intelligence OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/healthcare.html): Healthcare Engagement & Intelligence OS is a patient engagement and follow-up platform that connects EHR and appointment data to WhatsApp care journeys, so clinics and hospitals cut no-shows and complete more follow-ups. For Doctor / Practice Owner, Clinic or Day Hospital Manager and Hospital Group IT Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce no-show rate, improve follow-up completion, reduce manual reminder time and improve repeat visits.
- [Territory Revenue OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/territory-revenue.html): Territory Revenue OS is an offline-first field sales and beat planning app that gives reps a daily workflow and managers a live view of visits, orders, stock and missed outlets. For Sales Director / National Sales Head, Distributor Owner / COO and ERP / IT Head in South Africa. Helps teams improve outlet coverage, improve productive calls, improve order value and reduce idle time.
- [Compliance, Audit & Traceability OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/compliance-audit.html): Compliance, Audit & Traceability OS is an audit, CAPA and traceability platform that takes inspections from mobile evidence capture through risk scoring to verified closure and QR source proof. For Chief Compliance / Quality Officer, Audit Firm Owner / Operations Head and Buyer / Regulator / Supply-chain Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce closure cycle, reduce overdue findings, reduce report preparation and improve evidence completeness.
- [WhatsApp CRM & Conversational Commerce](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/whatsapp-crm.html): WhatsApp CRM & Conversational Commerce is a multi-user WhatsApp CRM that turns WhatsApp Business into a governed sales, service and commerce channel with routing, automation and analytics. For Marketing Head / Growth Lead, Sales / Service Head and Owner / Founder of SME in South Africa. Helps teams reduce first response time, reduce unowned chats, improve lead conversion and reduce manual handling.
- [CRM & Sales Pipeline](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/crm-pipeline.html): CRM & Sales Pipeline is a lean web and mobile CRM for growing sales teams, with configurable stages, next-action discipline and management visibility without a heavy implementation. For Founder / Managing Director, Sales Head / Revenue Operations and Sales Representatives / Field Team in South Africa. Helps teams reduce lead response time, improve follow-up completion, improve stage conversion and reduce sales cycle.
- [Agriculture Production & Traceability Platform](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/agriculture.html): Agriculture Production & Traceability Platform is a farm-to-batch traceability platform that records farms, crops, practices, inspections and procurement, and links every lot to a QR history buyers can trust. For Farm or Packhouse Manager, Food Brand / Buyer / Procurement Head and Agri Development Program Director in South Africa. Helps teams improve evidence completeness, reduce forecast error, reduce rejected lots and improve traceable volume.
- [Hyperlocal Digital Marketplace](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/hyperlocal-marketplace.html): Hyperlocal Digital Marketplace is a multi-vendor hyperlocal marketplace platform with customer and vendor apps, WhatsApp ordering, payments, commissions and delivery coordination, launched zone by zone. For Marketplace Sponsor / City or Community Operator, Anchor Supplier / Distributor and Local Vendor / Merchant Network in South Africa. Helps teams improve vendor activation, improve order conversion, improve fulfilment success and improve repeat orders.
- [Retail POS & Warehouse OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/retail-pos.html): Retail POS & Warehouse OS is an offline-first retail POS and warehouse system that keeps stores trading through load shedding and connection drops, then reconciles prices, stock and sales centrally. For Retail Owner / COO, Store Operations Head and CFO / Retail IT Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce checkout downtime, reduce reconciliation time, reduce stock variance and reduce sync exceptions.
- [Payroll, HRMS & Document Control](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/payroll-hrms.html): Payroll, HRMS & Document Control is a payroll, HRMS and employee document system that catches attendance and payroll exceptions before release and tracks document expiry. For HR Director, Payroll / Finance Head and Compliance / Internal Audit in South Africa. Helps teams reduce preparation time, improve early exception detection, reduce post-payroll corrections and reduce expiry incidents.
- [Accounting & Business Finance](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/accounting-finance.html): Accounting & Business Finance is an accounting and business finance system that connects operational transactions to banking, tax and management reporting with fast reconciliation. For Owner / CFO, Financial Controller / Accountant and Multi-company / Operations Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce days to close, reduce open reconciliation items, reduce overdue receivables and reduce reporting lag.
- [Fleet Intelligence OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/fleet.html): Fleet Intelligence OS is a fleet analytics layer over telematics that combines trip, fuel, maintenance and cost data to rank fuel and downtime leakage and assign action. For Fleet Director / Operations Head, CFO / Procurement Head and Dispatcher / Fleet Supervisor in South Africa. Helps teams reduce fuel variance, reduce downtime, improve maintenance compliance and reduce cost per kilometre.
- [Construction Operations OS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/construction.html): Construction Operations OS is a construction operations system that connects site requisitions, approvals, materials, fuel and labour to project cost, so margin risk shows before month end. For CEO / CFO, Project Manager and Procurement / Site Stores Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce approval cycle, reduce cost leakage, reduce material variance and improve cost visibility.
- [Property & Community Management](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/property.html): Property & Community Management is a property and community management platform for sectional title schemes, estates and rentals that gives managing agents, trustees, residents and vendors one record for requests, levies and documents. For Managing Agent / Portfolio Manager, Estate or Facility Manager and Body Corporate or HOA Trustees in South Africa. Helps teams reduce resolution time, reduce overdue levies, reduce repeat issues and reduce status calls.
- [Skill Intelligence & LMS](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/skill-lms.html): Skill Intelligence & LMS is a skill intelligence and learning platform that maps roles to skills, assigns targeted practice including AI role-play, and measures job readiness. For CHRO / L&D Head, School / Training Provider Leader and Sales / Service Operations Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce time to readiness, improve assessment score, improve practice completion and reduce coaching effort.
- [Ecommerce & Marketplace Intelligence](https://hemantam1.github.io/holaweb-solutions/solutions/ecommerce-intelligence.html): Ecommerce & Marketplace Intelligence is a cross-channel ecommerce analytics platform that unifies marketplace and webstore data into alerts and owned actions for stock, price, promotions and margin. For Brand / Ecommerce Director, Marketplace / Category Manager and CFO / Commercial Head in South Africa. Helps teams reduce stock-out days, improve promotion return, reduce reporting time and reduce margin leakage.
